_comment: Upstream worked example: GSE298371 (mouse small-intestine CD4, SPF vs germ-free). Keys from 'dataset' down are read by the original config-driven scripts (stages A-C, via imgt.load()); relative paths in them are relative to the run folder (the write root). 'pipeline' is read by scripts/run_upstream.py. Roots, environments and prefix aliases come from the voxel config (blocks 'upstream' and 'envs').
dataset: GSE298371 mouse small-intestine CD4 (T-bet-ZsGreen, SPF vs germ-free)

_project_notes.donor_col: mouse identity recovered from hashtags; the deposited donor column is the literal 'pool' on every contig and carries no identity
_project_notes.library_col: lane, from the aggr barcode suffix -1..-8; mouse and lane are crossed, so both are usable batch variables
_project_notes.folding: n_shards=5 x threads=2 measured fastest on this 10-core machine (6.2 s/receptor aggregate vs 6.9 for 9x1)
_project_notes.deposit_dir: prepared by code/b1_prepare_deposit.py: HTO singlets passing GEX QC, iNKT/MAIT V-J usage removed, dual-chain cells removed
_project_notes.max_chains_per_cell: declared by the pipeline schema but build_vdomains.py never reads it; dual-chain exclusion is applied in the prepared deposit instead

deposit._comment: the 10x deposit files read by stages A-C (paths.deposit)

hashtag_names._comment: a3_hto_demux.py: the condition of a cell comes from its hashtag's sample name (the name column of the HTO feature file, else the matrix feature name; this name is also the mouse id): the name is split at separator and part number condition_field (0 = the first) is the condition. No default: a data set without this block stops. Here GF_M_rep1 -> GF.
